name: How do I prepare my home for an interior restoration project?

mainEntity.name: How do I prepare my home for an interior restoration project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preparing your home for interior restoration involves several steps to ensure efficiency and protect your belongings. Start by decluttering and clearing the work areas of all furniture, personal items, and decor. If items cannot be moved, cover them thoroughly with drop cloths or plastic sheeting to protect them from dust and debris. Discuss with your contractor about utility shut-offs, access points, and designated staging areas for materials. Also, make arrangements for pets and children to be safe and away from the construction zone. Good preparation helps the project proceed smoothly and minimizes disruption.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare your home by decluttering and clearing work areas, covering immovable items, coordinating utility access, and ensuring pets and children are away from the construction zone.
